description: Paired real-agent benchmark for Progressive Context execution-efficiency guarantees.
baseline_description: Last main commit before Execution Efficiency rules were introduced.
candidate_description: Completed Phase 6 workflow with execution-efficiency rules, static protection, and measurement foundation.
token_accounting_requirement: Use the same provider-reported accounting in both arms; otherwise input_tokens + output_tokens consistently.
notes: Phase 7 benchmark files are Framework Source-only and must never enter Project Runtime.
One exploratory repetition is useful for smoke-testing the harness; use at least five paired repetitions per task before making stable median-efficiency claims.
The polling scenario is interpretable only when the agent harness can return control while a long-running command is still executing.
